title: Investigating Non-Transitivity in LLM-as-a-Judge
authors_zh: Yi Xu, Laura Ruis, Tim Rocktäschel, Robert Kirk
paper_type_zh: LLM 评测器可靠性与排名协议审计
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理数据与自动评测可靠性的研究者。
one_line: Shows ranking instability when pairwise LLM judge preferences violate transitivity.
审计两两 LLM 判决的非传递性，并以锦标赛聚合降低排名对基线的敏感度。
why: It adds a paper-backed reliability or failure-mode surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: evaluator/reward/verifier reliability, attack, uncertainty, or reward-hacking research.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Baseline pairwise LLM judging assumes preferences are transitive. When that assumption fails, a model ranking can change merely because a different baseline was chosen.

The paper audits this assumption in AlpacaEval, then replaces baseline-centred comparisons with tournament results fitted by a Bradley--Terry model; it also proposes the lower-cost Swim matching schedule.

The concern is ranking validity, not whether one answer is useful. A judge can prefer A to B, B to C, and C to A; then baseline win rate is not a global ordering. A leaderboard built from one reference system can therefore overstate or reverse differences that a broader comparison graph reveals. The output is a diagnostic and ranking protocol, not new response data or a new judge.

以单一基线做两两 LLM 评判默认偏好具传递性；若这一前提不成立，只更换基线就可能改变模型排名，因而把评测器偏差误当成能力差异。

论文在 AlpacaEval 审计该假设，以锦标赛比较和 Bradley--Terry 偏好模型替代基线中心的排名，并提出成本更低的 Swim 配对赛程。

这里关心的是排名是否有效，而非某一回答是否有用。评测器可能偏好 A 胜 B、B 胜 C、却又 C 胜 A；出现这种环时，相对单一基线的胜率不能定义全局顺序。因此只用一个参考系统的榜单可能夸大、甚至反转完整比较图所显示的差异。论文产出的是诊断和排名协议，不是新回答数据或新评测器。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
This is an evaluator-reliability audit: it treats pairwise verdicts as a preference graph rather than as independent contests against one baseline. Non-transitive cycles explain baseline-sensitive AlpacaEval rankings; round-robin evidence plus Bradley--Terry aggregation produces a more stable external ranking. No official dataset release is identified; the linked software implements the evaluation procedure.

The core shift is to retain all comparisons before estimating relative strength. Bradley--Terry converts wins into latent scores, while Swim selectively approximates information from exhaustive play. The feedback contract remains the LLM judge's preference; the safeguard is to expose its inconsistency instead of assuming it away. The official software is a reproducibility artifact, not a separately released benchmark dataset.

It is an audit layer above an existing judge, not a replacement for one.

这是一项评测器可靠性审计：它把两两判决视为偏好图，而非相对某个基线的独立竞赛。非传递环解释了 AlpacaEval 对基线敏感的排名；全循环证据经 Bradley--Terry 汇总后得到更稳定的外部排名。未确认官方数据集发布，所链接软件用于实现该评测流程。

核心改变是先保留全部比较，再估计相对强度。Bradley--Terry 把胜负转成潜在分数，Swim 则有选择地近似穷尽对局的信息。反馈契约仍是 LLM 评测器的偏好；保障在于暴露其不一致，而不是假定不存在。官方软件是复现工件，不是单独发布的基准数据集。

它是现有评测器之上的审计层，并不替代评测器本身。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect AlpacaEval pairwise judge outcomes among evaluated systems.
  2. Test whether preference cycles violate transitivity and measure ranking sensitivity to the chosen baseline.
  3. Run a round-robin schedule, then fit a Bradley--Terry model to all wins to obtain one ranking.
  4. Use Swiss-Wise Iterative Matchmaking (Swim) to choose dynamic matches when exhaustive round-robin cost is prohibitive.

Reproduction requires the exact judge, prompts, model versions, comparison budget, and AlpacaEval version; sampling settings are not fully disclosed here.

The verifier is not an answer checker: it is the set of pairwise judge outputs used to accept a win edge. The Bradley--Terry fit decides the final score ordering from those edges; Swim decides which unobserved edges to request next under a limited comparison budget. Reproduction should also preserve candidate order or explicitly counterbalance it, because position effects could otherwise be mistaken for non-transitivity. The primary paper and linked code must be checked for exact implementation defaults.

1. 收集被测系统之间的 AlpacaEval 两两评测器判决。
  2. 检验偏好环是否违背传递性，并量化排名对所选基线的敏感度。
  3. 执行全循环赛，将全部胜负拟合为 Bradley--Terry 模型，输出统一排名。
  4. 当全循环代价过高时，以 Swiss-Wise Iterative Matchmaking（Swim）动态选择对局。

复现须固定评测器、提示词、模型版本、比较预算和 AlpacaEval 版本；采样细节在此未完整披露。

这里的验证器不是答案检查器，而是决定胜负边的两两评测器输出。Bradley--Terry 拟合依据这些边决定最终分数顺序；Swim 则在比较预算有限时决定下一条未观测边。复现还须保留候选顺序或显式做平衡，因为位置效应可能被误认成非传递性。确切实现默认值须核对原论文和链接代码。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The central AlpacaEval comparison tests agreement with Chatbot Arena. Moving from the baseline method to round-robin plus Bradley--Terry raises Spearman correlation from 95.0% to 96.4% and Kendall correlation from 82.1% to 86.3% (abstract). This supports better ranking agreement in that setting, not universal judge correctness or a guarantee for other benchmarks.

The controlled contrast is primarily aggregation protocol: baseline comparisons versus the tournament and preference model, with Chatbot Arena as an external ranking reference. The absolute gains are 1.4 Spearman points and 4.2 Kendall points. These metrics assess rank agreement, not individual-verdict accuracy; the result does not identify every cause of the cycles, quantify human-label accuracy, or prove Swim reaches the same result at every budget.

核心 AlpacaEval 比较考察与 Chatbot Arena 的一致性。由基线法改为全循环赛加 Bradley--Terry 后，Spearman 相关从 95.0% 升至 96.4%，Kendall 相关从 82.1% 升至 86.3%（摘要）。这支持该设置下更一致的排名，不能证明评测器普遍正确，亦不能保证适用于其他基准。

受控差异主要是聚合协议：基线比较对照锦标赛和偏好模型，Chatbot Arena 作为外部排名参照。绝对提升为 Spearman 1.4 点、Kendall 4.2 点。这些指标衡量排名一致性而非单个判决准确性；结果不能识别每个偏好环的原因、量化人类标签准确率，也不能证明 Swim 在每种预算下都得到同样结果。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Conventional AlpacaEval-style evaluation fixes a baseline and assumes pairwise wins compose transitively. This paper changes the decision object to the full comparison graph, diagnoses cycles, and aggregates a tournament with Bradley--Terry; Swim changes match selection rather than the judge itself. The contribution is ranking protocol reliability, not a new judge model.

The nearest convention is a baseline-centred leaderboard. The innovation moves from an implicit scalar win rate to graph-aware inference, then adds a budget-conscious scheduling approximation. It neither replaces response generators nor claims to remove judge bias. It makes one hidden ranking assumption observable and testable before results are reported or used as a training signal.

常规 AlpacaEval 式评测固定一个基线，并假定两两胜负可传递地合成。本文把决策对象改为完整比较图，诊断偏好环，再用 Bradley--Terry 汇总锦标赛；Swim 改变的是对局选择而非评测器本身。其新意是排名协议的可靠性，而不是新评测模型。

最接近的惯例是以基线为中心的榜单。本文从隐含的标量胜率转向图感知推断，再加入预算敏感的赛程近似。它既不替换回答生成器，也不宣称消除评测器偏差；价值在于让一项隐藏的排名假设在结果报告或作为训练信号前变得可观测、可检验。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The reported gains are anchored to AlpacaEval and Chatbot Arena correlation, so they do not establish that every task, judge, or model set has the same cycles. Tournament judging costs more comparisons; Swim is intended to mitigate that cost but must be evaluated under a fixed budget. Reusers should audit order/position effects and report the exact pairing schedule.

The strongest curator risk is treating tournament ranking as ground truth: Arena correlation is an external agreement target, not proof of objective response quality. Non-transitivity may interact with prompt design, candidate order and response distribution, so a cycle rate from one release should not be copied to another. Before reuse, publish the compared pool, pairing graph, judge identity and order randomisation; otherwise the stability claim cannot be independently audited.

报告的提升锚定于 AlpacaEval 和与 Chatbot Arena 的相关性，不能说明每个任务、评测器或模型集合都会出现同样的偏好环。锦标赛需要更多比较；Swim 旨在降低成本，但须在固定预算下检验。复用时应审计顺序/位置效应，并报告确切配对赛程。

最重要的整理风险是把锦标赛排名当作真值：与 Arena 的相关只是外部一致性目标，不是回答客观质量的证明。非传递性还可能与提示设计、候选顺序和回答分布交互，不能把某次发布测得的环率照搬到另一场评测。复用前应公布候选池、配对图、评测器身份和顺序随机化，否则稳定性主张无法独立审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this protocol when ranking several instruction-following systems with an LLM judge. Supply pairwise outputs, run cycle checks and a tournament aggregation, then compare the resulting ranking with an external human-preference reference. Do not use a baseline-only leaderboard as evidence of stable ordering when comparison budget or judge position control is absent.

For a release audit, fix the candidate set and prompts, collect comparisons to inspect cycles, then fit Bradley--Terry and report both graph and ranking. Success is improved agreement with a separately maintained human-preference reference, not a higher internal score. If full round-robin is infeasible, use Swim with a stated budget and a budget-matched comparison. It is unsuitable without a credible external reference or controlled pairing.

当需要以 LLM 评测器为多个指令跟随系统排序时，可复用该协议：输入两两输出，检查偏好环并做锦标赛汇总，再与外部人类偏好参照比较排名。若没有比较预算或评测器位置控制，不应把只对单一基线的榜单当作稳定顺序的证据。

做发布审计时，应固定候选池和提示词，收集足以检查偏好环的比较，再拟合 Bradley--Terry 并同时报告比较图与排名。成功标准不是更高的内部得分，而是与独立维护的人类偏好参照有更高一致性。无法全循环时，可在明确预算下用 Swim，并与等预算方案比较。没有可信外部参照或受控配对时不适用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Pairwise LLM rankings can change with the baseline because preferences are non-transitive.
  2. Diagnose cycles before treating wins as a scalar score.
  3. Aggregate a round-robin tournament with Bradley--Terry.
  4. The key anchor is 95.0%→96.4% Spearman and 82.1%→86.3% Kendall versus Chatbot Arena.
  5. Use Swim for limited budgets, but validate its schedule and position controls.

1. 两两 LLM 排名会因基线不同而改变，因为偏好并不传递。
  2. 在把胜负当作标量分数前，先诊断偏好环。
  3. 以 Bradley--Terry 汇总全循环锦标赛。
  4. 关键证据是相对 Chatbot Arena，Spearman 由 95.0% 至 96.4%，Kendall 由 82.1% 至 86.3%。
  5. 预算有限可用 Swim，但须验证赛程和位置控制。
